description_en: Exposes the public entry point for the MaxAgent service
name: ChatSse

parameters.help_en: The question from the user. This parameter can be left empty when used with commandId, in which case the task input is provided by the preset command
parameters.help_zh: 用户的问题。与commandId配合使用时可留空，由预置命令提供任务输入
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for a multi-turn conversation. Conversations with the same chatId share the same context. The value must start with a lowercase letter or a digit, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The length is 1 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 多轮对话的唯一标识，同一个对话chatId共享一个上下文。以小写字母或数字开头，可包含小写字母、数字、下划线和短划线，长度1~64个字符
parameters.name: chat_id

parameters.help_en: The credential used to verify the ownership of the AccessKey identity. This parameter is automatically injected by the POP gateway when the request is forwarded. Callers do not need to pass this parameter
parameters.help_zh: AK身份归属校验凭证。由POP网关在请求转发时自动注入，调用方无需传入
parameters.name: ak_proven

parameters.help_en: The type of the agent. Valid values: MaxAgent (default, MaxCompute intelligent assistant) and DataAgent (data analytics agent)
parameters.help_zh: Agent类型。取值：MaxAgent（默认值，MaxCompute智能助手）或DataAgent（数据分析Agent）
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project. This parameter is used to specify the project context for the current conversation
parameters.help_zh: MaxCompute项目名称，用于指定本次对话的项目上下文
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the project schema model. The server does not use this parameter in the current version. Passing this parameter does not affect the call result
parameters.help_zh: 项目Schema模型标识。当前版本服务端未使用该参数，传入与否不影响调用结果
parameters.name: project_schema_model

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the call source. This parameter is passed to the agent context along with the request to mark the channel from which the current conversation is initiated
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源标识，随请求传入Agent上下文，用于标记本次对话的发起渠道
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The language of the reply. Valid values: zh-CN (default, Chinese) and en (English). Language values starting with en are processed as English. Values such as zh, zh-CN, zh-Hans, and zh-SG are processed as Chinese. Other values fall back to Chinese
parameters.help_zh: 回复语言。取值：zh-CN（默认值，中文）或en（英文）。以en开头的语言值按英文处理，zh、zh-CN、zh-Hans、zh-SG按中文处理，其余值回退为中文
parameters.name: x_acs_accept_language

parameters.help_en: The ID of the semantic pack. This parameter is used to specify the semantic pack context used during DataAgent analysis. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is left empty, no semantic pack is specified
parameters.help_zh: 语义包ID，用于指定DataAgent分析时使用的语义包上下文。可选参数，留空时不指定语义包
parameters.name: semantic_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute schema. This parameter is used to specify the schema context for the current conversation in the three-level model (project.schema.table)
parameters.help_zh: MaxCompute Schema名称，用于三层模型（project.schema.table）下指定本次对话的Schema上下文
parameters.name: schema_name

parameters.help_en: The analysis mode of DataAgent. Valid values: standard (standard mode, where the agent directly reasons and calls tools to complete the analysis) and deep (deep analysis mode, where the analysis is delegated to the deep analysis engine). If this parameter is left empty, the default mode is used
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent分析模式。取值：standard（标准模式，由Agent直接推理并调用工具完成分析）或deep（深度分析模式，委托深度分析引擎执行）。留空时按默认模式处理
parameters.name: analysis_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the preset command. This parameter is used to directly trigger a published command or Solutions workflow. You can call the GetAgentCommands operation to query active commands. When commandId is specified, the analysis pattern and node input are determined by the command definition
parameters.help_zh: 预置命令ID，用于直接触发已发布的命令或解决方案工作流。可通过GetAgentCommands接口查询可用命令。指定commandId时，分析模式与任务输入由命令定义决定
parameters.name: command_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically generate an interpretation report after the command execute is completed. If this parameter is set to true, commandId must point to a Solutions workflow. Otherwise, a 400 error is returned. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否在命令执行完成后自动生成解读报告。取值为true时要求commandId指向解决方案工作流，否则返回400错误。默认值：false
parameters.name: report_on_completion

parameters.help_en: The ID of an existing analysis run. The value is a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal string. This parameter is used only to re-initiate an interpretation for a completed analysis run. This parameter cannot be used together with prompt, commandId, reportOnCompletion, or the deep mode. Otherwise, a 400 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 已有分析运行的ID，32位小写十六进制字符串。仅用于对已完成的分析运行重新发起解读，不能与prompt、commandId、reportOnCompletion或deep模式同时使用，否则返回400错误
parameters.name: analysis_run_id

parameters.help_en: The JSON string passed when a new standard DataAgent conversation is started in a dashboard. The value can be up to 32,768 characters in length. The string includes the dashboard ID `dashboardId`, the current version `version`, the operation intent `intent` (`read` for interpretation and `modify` for modification), and optional `clientFilters` (up to 40 items). You must also provide `prompt`, set `agentType` to DataAgent, and omit the command, run ID, and automatic report options
parameters.help_zh: 在看板中开启新的 standard DataAgent 对话时传入的 JSON 字符串，最多 32768 个字符。包含看板 ID `dashboardId`、当前版本 `version`、操作意图 `intent`（`read` 解读，`modify` 修改）及可选的 `clientFilters`（最多 40 项）。请同时提供 `prompt`，选择 `agentType=DataAgent` 并省略命令、运行 ID 和自动报告选项
parameters.name: dashboard_context

schema.description_en: The Server-Sent Events (SSE) event stream. For event types and JSON payloads, see the response description. The current execution ends with a done event, and errors are returned as error events
schema.description_zh: SSE事件流。事件类型与JSON载荷见返回说明；本轮执行以done事件结束，错误以error事件返回
schema.example:
event: message
data: {"conversationId":"123456789012****#cn-shanghai#1ee04bea-0488-46b6-b85b-827e3cd37e55","turnId":"9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a0","content":"您有以下项目：odps_project。","role":"assistant"}
